info.title: Extreme Platform ONE REST API - IAM
info.description: Extreme Platform ONE™ IAM (Identity and Access Management) API allows users to manage organization setting, user profile, identities, roles, external Identity Providers (IDPs), Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), API Keys, etc.
